title: Apartment Search
searchIntent: grok bot to find an apartment
intro: Flat hunting is the job people describe first when asked what they would want an agent for, and it is easy to see why: listings move fast, the good ones go in hours, and the work is refreshing the same four sites at the same four times a day. Unusually for this site, the strongest candidate here is purpose-built rather than a general browsing template pointed at a property site — it takes your criteria once and sweeps the major portals on a schedule. The constraint is the one every tool in this category runs into. Property portals are hostile to automated access, so a bot that sweeps twice a day is making a trade against getting blocked, and twice a day is not the continuous watch that the competitive listings actually demand. Treat it as a wider net rather than a faster one, and keep your own alerts running alongside it.

bots.fitReason: The only candidate actually built for this: a 12-hour sweep of Redfin, Zillow, Craigslist, Facebook, MLS and ApartmentList against criteria it takes on first run. Twice-daily is not the continuous watch the good listings demand, and portal blocking remains its problem as much as anyone's.
